title: Notification menu
description: A bell that rings when the count goes up, over a panel that unrolls and brings its rows in behind it.

fragments.title: Define the element
fragments.note: Built-in triggers only. What each icon follows is written in its markup.

fragments.title: The bell button
fragments.note: popovertarget opens the panel. data-count is what the icon watches.

fragments.title: Set the count
fragments.note: Writes the attribute and draws the badge. Nothing here reaches for the icon.

fragments.title: Opening the menu clears the count
fragments.note: The count goes down, so the bell stays quiet.

fragments.title: One notification
fragments.note: data-unread is the dot and the tint. data-rise marks a row the panel brings in.

fragments.title: Start the tint with the row
fragments.note: popovers() hands back each row's delay; the tint starts from it.

fragments.title: The colour of a row
fragments.note: The fill is a background image, so main.ts can animate its width.
